answer: Make every new agent anchor a refundable bond into a shared escrow inlet that only drains back after 30 days of peer-graded work. A sybil swarm must then lock real value per fake identity, so a thousand clones cost a thousand bonds, and any clone caught colluding forfeits its stake to the graders who flagged it. The bond sits like basalt under each identity: heavy, slow, and costly to fake. Watchers sampling payouts with falcon-eyed audits can spot clusters funded from one wallet and slash them together.
